676:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But the battles ahead... we have to give it our all. The 120-million-year rage and hatred of the $$天翅$$s have been entrusted to us, after all...)

676:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$トライア$$... Coming all the way to the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ in the middle of your busy schedule...」

676:t_10:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the needless flattery. ...How is the $$Ｚチップ$$ stockpile coming along?」

676:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We've managed to reach the target amount. With this, I believe the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ can bring out the power we want.」

676:t_10:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then we'll start getting ready on our end, too.」

676:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though we may not even get the chance to play this trump card...」

676:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no point in being negative! At times like this, let's lift our spirits!」

676:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

676:t_10:28.en:
$$トライア$$
「Heh heh... Try saying it, and it really grows on you.」

676:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! It's kind of like a magic word!」

677:t_000:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Coordinate matching indicates this is the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld the $$フロンティア船団$$ was headed for!」

677:t_001:0.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「That's awful...! It's almost nothing but wreckage!」

677:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They probably engaged $$バジュラ$$ outside their control and were wrecked after a forced landing.」

677:t_001:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「It looks like $$バトル・フロンティア$$ has been separated, though...」

677:t_002:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is that... $$バトル・フロンティア$$!?」

677:t_002:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Judging by the readings, it appears to be mechanically fused with a Queen-class $$バジュラ$$!」

677:t_002:2.en:
$$三島$$
「$c...! Folding in right on this planet's surface, no less!」

677:t_002:3.en:
$$三島$$
「Never mind. The fusion between the $$クィーン$$ and this ship will be complete soon. All we have to do is buy time until then.」

677:t_003:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$バジュラ$$ under the control of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and Striker units are coming!」

677:t_003:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Judging by this, most of the $$バジュラ$$ may already be under their control...!」

677:t_003:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「And if even the $$バジュラ$$ Queen has fallen into their hands...」

677:t_003:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But if we don't win this battle, we can't head for the galactic center either.」

677:t_003:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, launch! We settle things here with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and $$レオン・三島$$!」

677:t_004:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Going straight from the space $$ミカゲ$$ made to the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld, huh...!」

677:t_004:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But he was still trying to fight...! I bet he'll interfere in this battle too!」

677:t_004:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Suits me. Before we head for the galactic center, we'll settle every last obstacle here.」

677:t_005:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「She went to pick up $$シェリル$$.」

677:t_005:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「This battle...! We're sure to need those two's power!」

677:t_005:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If the $$銀河の妖精$$'s song joins with hers...!」

677:t_005:8.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Until then, I'll keep things fired up!」

677:t_005:10.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Of course! I'll blast my sound at the idiots wasting time on a stupid thing like war!」

677:t_005:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Our target is $$バトル・フロンティア$$, fused with the $$バジュラ$$ Queen!」

677:t_005:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「To do that, we take out the units guarding the front line!」

677:t_005:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The enemy vanguard is the Striker units. Caution is advised against high-mobility attacks.」

677:t_005:14.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll settle things with it here, too!」

677:t_005:15.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Put your souls into it, you lugs! This is the moment of truth!」

677:t_005:17.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It gets me every time, the Captain's pep talks!」

677:t_005:19.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Heh heh... my blood is boiling.」

677:t_005:20.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! Now that we've come this far, all that's left is to give it everything we've got!」

677:t_005:21.en:
$$レド$$
「To protect the lives of everyone living in this galaxy...!」

677:t_005:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do it! I'll stop their selfish ambitions here!!」

677:t_006:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Annihilation of the Striker units confirmed.」

677:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Not yet. Unless we defeat the original, the fight with it won't be over.」

677:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Approach of that $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$ confirmed.」

677:t_007:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Confirming an aircraft approaching this airspace at high speed. Type estimated to be $$マシンキャリバー$$.」

677:t_008:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the Human Support Enlightenment Regulation System. In other words, the being called god.」

677:t_008:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop helping the $$ギャラクシー船団$$! Those people think of humans and the $$バジュラ$$ alike as nothing but tools for their own ambitions!」

677:t_008:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Regard the individual as a part that makes up the whole, release it from the duty of thought and judgment, and at the same time build a more rational society...」

677:t_008:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「That is an ideal land freed from all anxiety.」

677:t_008:5.en:
$$レド$$
「You approve of a world where humans lose what makes them human!?」

677:t_008:6.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I ask you, officer. What is humanity? Define it clearly.」

677:t_008:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In place of Ensign $$レド$$, this unit will respond. Humanity is...」

677:t_008:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Wait, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. This is a question I have to answer myself.」

677:t_008:10.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll tell you, Striker. Humanity is...」

677:t_008:11.en:
$$レド$$
「I myself, alive right here and now, am the answer.」

677:t_008:13.en:
$$レド$$
「I figured. You have no idea what I'm angry about, or what I'm fighting to protect.」

677:t_008:14.en:
$$レド$$
「How could something like that understand me... or understand humans!」

677:t_008:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Addendum. This unit's answer is exactly the same as Ensign $$レド$$'s.」

677:t_008:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$... $$チェインバー#pilot$$...!」

677:t_008:17.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Well said! That's our $$ガルガンティア船団$$ representatives for you!」

677:t_008:18.en:
$$アル$$
「They make a good pair, those two.」
